why: PartB2 wraps several targets in `section B2 ... variable {X} ... end B2`. The text-splitting assembler put the section lines in the wrong chunks ("Invalid name after end: Expected B2, but found PartB2"); since Phase 4.3 each run of declarations is written inside its own scope (LeanInfo context) and the case assembles and compiles. The accepted solution (4e34b886) came from the mission-specific assemble_child.py.
